q1_issues.issue: The antecedentless "It" is given the witness sk_it_1, named after the pronoun instead of a class and carrying no typing atom at all, whereas the instruction set requires an sk_<class>_<n> witness plus its Member atom ("it" → the salient kind, else thing).

The definite plural "the views" — the instruction set's own example of a definite plural — is encoded as a single witness (Member sk_view_1 view) instead of a group witness (GroupOf <group> view), so the plurality is lost.
Neither party gets the ordinary type atom the multi-word-name rule requires beside its Name: (Member free_soil_party party) and (Member republican_party party) are missing.

q2_gaps: coordinated possessors inside one genitive of-phrase ("the views of A and B") — the instruction set states the distributive default for clause-level coordination but not whether the possessed head is replicated per possessor or shared as one symbol
notes: Theme (not Patient) for endorse, the Past atom, and the Possession head with possessed-first argument order are all correct.
